[Dataverse has grown from {{< var dataverse.datasets_2020 >}} datasets in 2020 to roughly {{< var dataverse.datasets_released >}} released today.]{.lede}

Dataverse, UCLA's institutional repository, which DSC operates, has grown from
{{< var dataverse.datasets_2020 >}} datasets and {{< var dataverse.downloads_2020 >}}
downloads in January 2020 to roughly **{{< var dataverse.datasets_released >}}
released datasets and over {{< var dataverse.downloads_total >}} downloads** today
({{< var dataverse.datasets_with_drafts >}} counting drafts and restricted deposits).
This is the same hosting commitment the Library made in the 2014 transfer ("necessary
technological infrastructure for continued hosting of software, data, and data
analysis tools"), grown considerably since.

Dataverse and Redivis are funded through the original SSDA gift fund, University
Librarian discretionary funds, and the Library's central budget. The Archive's core
subscriptions (<abbr class="term" title="Inter-university Consortium for Political
and Social Research">ICPSR</abbr>, ~$47K/year, and the Roper Center, ~$8K/year) moved
years ago onto the Library's general membership fund, the same treatment other
research libraries give large database subscriptions. That freed the Archive's
original gift fund to cover the AWS infrastructure costs for Dataverse and Potree
instead.
